name: Purple Haze
summary: **Purple Haze** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] whose 1960s namesake was never a documented, seed-grown strain, with sources treating the original as more myth than a bred line. Modern seed releases sold under the name are commonly described as a cross of [[purple-thai|Purple Thai]] and [[haze|Haze]]. No single breeder or release date can be confirmed for the name as a whole.
